no_adcom_quote.quote: No AC meeting was held, as this was not the first drug in class, the application did not raise significant public health questions on the role if the biologic, and there were no controversial issues that would benefit from advisory committee discussion.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for BLA761156 (SOGROYA/somapacitan-beco). The Summary Review explains the FDA declined to hold an AC because somapacitan was not the first drug in class, the application raised no significant public-health questions, and there were no controversial issues warranting committee discussion; the Medical Review likewise records the advisory committee section as 'Not applicable for this submission.' Because no committee was held, there are no AC-driven linkages to the approval.
